subject: Short access window guidance for debugging customer-reported regression
body:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblehealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 8 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short access window to logs for regression triage

Hi Connor —

We are seeing a regression in inference latency for a small subset of requests since the 2028-07-04 rollout. Our SEs traced the issue to an unusual tokenization path and have asked for a one-time, read-only access window to the last 48 hours of request/response traces for three tenant IDs so they can reproduce locally.

Can Redwood provide a 72-hour access window (read-only, no export) scoped to the three tenant IDs below? We understand the sensitivity and will sign any required attestation.

Tenant IDs: NH-7783, NH-7784, NH-7789
Impact: ~0.2% of requests; blocks a production anomaly triage
Urgency: high — customer-facing P0

Thanks,
Alex Gomez
Senior SRE, NimbleHealth

---
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Jul 2028 09:35:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short access window to logs for regression triage

Laura / Rishi — looping you in. NimbleHealth is asking for a timeboxed, read-only view into 48h traces for three tenant IDs to debug a regression. They propose 72 hrs access; they will not export.

Questions for policy/legal:
- Is a 72h view OK if we enforce no-export and an RBAC audit?
- What attachments/attestations do we need signed (DocuSign)?
- Any region constraints (their data is US-only)?

I attached the tenant list and a rough manifest. Alex — can you confirm the environment names (prod/region) so we scope correctly?

Thanks,
Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short access window to logs for regression triage

Connor / Rishi — quick notes from Ops/CS perspective:
- We can create a timeboxed policy that grants read-only access to the specific tenant IDs and route it through our staging-to-prod audit hooks.
- No exports, no console snapshots; access via a restricted support view with two-person approval and audit logging.
- We normally limit windows to 48 hours, but will consider 72 if Legal signs off.

Alex — please attach the signed retention_exemption_form (we provided the PDF) and a brief statement of purpose. Also confirm the exact prod deploy tag and time range for the traces you need.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention_exemption_form.pdf (fillable)

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@nimblehealth.com>, NimbleHealth Legal <legal@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short access window to logs for regression triage

Connor / Laura / Alex — Legal has reviewed and approved a conditional 72-hour read-only window with the following constraints:
- Access limited to named SEs (Alex may nominate up to 3 SRE/SEs) and two Redwood engineers (ops@redwood.ai) for support; RBAC entries will be timebound.
- No export, no copy/paste; access via secure viewer only.
- Access will be logged to the customer's audit trail and to our internal compliance logs; logs will be retained per standard retention policy afterward with no additional copies.
- NimbleHealth must return a signed DocuSign attestation before we enable access (link sent).

Alex — please complete the DocuSign and confirm the three SREs. Once received, Ops will schedule the window (we aim for within 6 hours of sign-off).

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: docsign_access_agreement.docx (DocuSign template), nimble_debug_manifest.csv
